title: COLDCARD wallet RNG flaw likely linked to $88 million Bitcoin theft
summary: A Coinkite advisory says affected seeds include those generated on Mk2 and Mk3 firmware versions 4.0.1 through 4.1.9, Mk4 and Mk5 devices before standard version 5.6.0 or Edge version 6.6.0X, and Q devices before standard version 1.5.0Q or Edge version 6.6.0QX.
